    🗓️ Steps to Get Quotes
    • Gather details: Keep your driver's license, VIN, and mileage ready. 
    • Compare options: Check at least three different company estimates. 
    • Adjust deductibles: Raise deductibles to lower your monthly premium. 
    💡 Information Needed for Accurate Quotes
    • Personal data: Date of birth, address, and driving history. 
    • Vehicle info: Make, model, year, and vehicle identification number. 
    • Coverage levels: Choose between liability-only or full coverage.
